capabilities: capture text and links from the iOS Shortcuts share sheet or Android share menu
queue captures in a private Cloudflare Worker and D1 database
append captures to one Markdown table per day
encrypt queued content with AES-256-GCM and delete it after confirmed storage
sync automatically when the desktop app starts or while it is open
disambiguation: Not a mobile Obsidian client; the phone only sends captures and never runs the Obsidian app.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) with a step-by-step beginner tutorial, troubleshooting table, and final checklist; users must deploy their own relay to a free Cloudflare account, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push text or links shared on a phone into the desktop app, and the phone does not even need to run Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Messages are stored temporarily in a private Cloudflare Worker and D1 database owned by the user
